summary: The data science strategy is conceptually very strong, correctly leveraging the symmetric nature of the task through data augmentation and test-time symmetric predictions without causing target leakage. However, execution flaws severely undermine the solution: categorical encoding is done independently on each split causing misaligned features, test predictions are overwritten in each fold rather than ensembled, and additionally trained models (CatBoost, XGBoost) are entirely unused.
